title: Nash Equilibrium
body_html:
Nash Equilibrium

A strategy profile $s\in S$ is a Nash equilibrium if no player can profitably deviate unilaterally: $$ g_i(t_i,s_{-i})\le g_i(s_i,s_{-i}) \quad\text{for all } i\in I,\ t_i\in S_i. $$ Equivalently, $$ s_i\in BR_i(s_{-i}) \quad\text{for every } i\in I. $$

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 1.3.4] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Nash equilibrium as no profitable unilateral deviation.
  • [MFoGT, Definition 4.5.1] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Formal definition for strategic games.
